text: Writing the real after-action report for the svc-core-banking-sync incident -- the document the next analyst actually needs.

A factual timeline: credential reuse and an interactive sign-in from Romania on October 12th, a clean nightly check the next morning, and Renata's own enrichment script flagging it roughly 36 hours later.
What went right and wrong, stated plainly: zero-trust containment held throughout; the exclusion built to catch exactly this kind of sign-in couldn't, by design, missing the 4-hour target.
Four follow-up items, each with a name and a real date -- Renata, Thomas Reyes, and Priya Nair all own a piece.
Next: the series finale -- how Renata tells this entire project in a job interview.
